an4.273:1.1: ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti parañ ca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti micchādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti micchādiṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati . . . pe . . .
an4.273:2.1: Attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti parañ ca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti sammādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti sammādiṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. Ime kho catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. Vaggo.
